title: Earth Is Now Heating Up Twice as Fast as in Previous Decades

mock_data.title: Earth Is Now Heating Up Twice as Fast as in Previous Decades
mock_data.passage:
Global warming has accelerated and is now happening twice as fast as in previous decades, meaning major climate catastrophes could happen sooner than expected.

Earth was warming by about 0.18°C per decade prior to 2013–14. Since then, it has been heating up by about 0.36°C per decade, according to an analysis by Stefan Rahmstorf at the University of Potsdam, Germany, and his colleagues.

If warming continues at this rate, humanity could breach the Paris Agreement goal of limiting warming to 1.5°C in 2028, even sooner than other research has projected.

"Every tenth of a degree matters and makes the impact of global warming worse in terms of extreme weather events, in terms of ecosystem impacts, also the risk of crossing tipping points," says Rahmstorf. "The world, apart from the US, is trying to halt global warming, reduce it, and that's why the fact that it's now actually doing the opposite, accelerating, is of great concern."

After a string of record-hot years, climate scientists began widely debating in 2023 whether global warming is speeding up. But natural fluctuations, such as the El Niño climate phase, which caused additional warming in 2023 and 2024, made it difficult to tell if the faster rise in temperatures was due to climate change or just random weather.

Rahmstorf's study is the first to find a statistically significant acceleration due to climate change, making that attribution with 98 per cent confidence.

The team analysed five different datasets of global temperature, some of which show a higher number. According to the analysis of the dataset from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts, global warming could reach 1.5°C above the preindustrial period this year, based on a 20-year average.

Warm-water coral reefs are starting to collapse, and breaching 1.5°C risks crossing other tipping points like irreversible melting of Greenland and west Antarctica and the dieback of the Amazon rainforest.

Many scientists think the acceleration in global heating was caused mainly by a crackdown in 2020 on sulphur dioxide in shipping emissions. While that substance is harmful to human health, it also formed a haze of aerosols that was blocking sunlight and cooling the planet.

Now that this sunlight has been unblocked, the warming rate may slow down, but it's hard to say for sure, says Rahmstorf. The transition away from fossil fuels will continue to diminish air pollution that is masking warming.

"There will be further aerosol reductions, [but] probably not as rapid as those shipping emissions were reduced," he says. "It's quite possible that the warming rate will be lower in the next decade."

In addition to El Niño, the authors estimated the effects of volcanic eruptions, which also create sun-blocking haze, and increased solar radiation during cycles of high sunspots. After excluding these effects, they fitted two types of curve to global temperatures, both of which showed an acceleration in warming, although at different times.

It's unlikely, however, that the researchers were able to completely remove the temperature effects of El Niño, volcanoes and sunspots, according to Zeke Hausfather at Berkeley Earth in California. That means they could be slightly overestimating how much global warming has sped up. But the study does offer convincing proof it has quickened, he says.

"The broader takeaway is that we have strong evidence for acceleration even if we don't know precisely how much the rate of warming has increased as of yet," Hausfather says. "We will need to wait a few more years to get more data."
mock_data.passageB1:
The Earth is getting hotter faster than before. This means that big problems with the weather could happen sooner than we thought.

Before 2013, the Earth was getting warmer by about 0.18°C every ten years. But now, it is getting warmer by about 0.36°C every ten years. This information comes from a study by Stefan Rahmstorf and other scientists in Germany.

If the Earth keeps getting warmer at this rate, we might not be able to keep the warming below 1.5°C. This is the goal of the Paris Agreement, an international agreement to fight climate change. We could reach this limit as early as 2028, even faster than some scientists have predicted.

Rahmstorf says that even a small amount of warming can make things worse. It can lead to more extreme weather, like very strong storms or very hot temperatures. It can also harm nature and increase the risk of big problems that are hard to fix. Most countries are trying to stop or slow down global warming. So, the fact that it is now getting faster is a big concern.

In 2023, after some very hot years, scientists started to talk about whether global warming was speeding up. But it was hard to know for sure. This is because there are natural changes in the weather, like El Niño. El Niño made the Earth warmer in 2023 and 2024. So, it was difficult to tell if the faster warming was because of climate change or just the weather.

Rahmstorf's study is the first one to show that climate change is really making the warming happen faster. The scientists are 98% sure that this is true.

The scientists looked at five different sets of information about global temperature. Some of these sets showed higher temperatures. According to one set of information, from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts, the world could be 1.5°C warmer than before the industrial revolution this year. This is based on looking at the average temperature over 20 years.

Coral reefs are already starting to die because the water is too warm. If the Earth gets 1.5°C warmer, other big problems could happen. For example, the ice in Greenland and West Antarctica could melt completely, and the Amazon rainforest could die.

Many scientists think that the warming is happening faster because of a new rule in 2020. The rule limited the amount of sulphur dioxide that ships could release into the air. Sulphur dioxide is bad for people's health, but it also created a haze that blocked sunlight and cooled the Earth.

Now that there is less of this haze, more sunlight is reaching the Earth, and the temperature is going up. The warming might slow down in the future, but it is hard to say for sure, according to Rahmstorf. As we stop using fossil fuels, there will be less air pollution that is hiding the warming.

Rahmstorf says that there will be less pollution in the air, but maybe not as quickly as when the rules for ships changed. He thinks that the warming might not be as fast in the next ten years.

The scientists also looked at the effects of volcanic eruptions and changes in the sun. Volcanic eruptions can create haze that blocks sunlight. The sun can also give off more energy at certain times. After taking these things into account, the scientists found that the Earth is warming faster.

However, another scientist, Zeke Hausfather, says that it is hard to know exactly how much faster the Earth is warming. He says that the scientists might not have been able to completely remove the effects of El Niño, volcanoes, and the sun. But he agrees that the study shows that the Earth is warming faster.

Hausfather says that the important thing is that we have good evidence that the warming is speeding up, even if we don't know exactly how much. He says that we need to wait a few more years to get more information.

Before 2013-14, the Earth's temperature was rising by about 0.18°C every ten years. This suggests a concerning trend that needs serious attention.

Rahmstorf's study is the first to definitively link the acceleration to climate change with a high degree of certainty (98 per cent confidence). This provides strong evidence that human activities are significantly impacting the planet's temperature.

According to the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts' data, global warming could reach 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels this year, based on a 20-year average. These events would have devastating consequences for the planet.

Many scientists believe that the acceleration in global heating is primarily due to the 2020 crackdown on sulphur dioxide emissions from ships. While this substance is harmful to human health, it also created a haze of aerosols that reflected sunlight and had a cooling effect on the planet.

Now that this sunlight is no longer being blocked, the warming rate may slow down, but this is uncertain, according to Rahmstorf. The move away from fossil fuels will continue to reduce air pollution that is masking the true extent of warming.

In addition to El Niño, the researchers considered the effects of volcanic eruptions, which also create sun-blocking haze, and increased solar radiation during periods of high sunspot activity. After accounting for these factors, they used two types of curve to analyse global temperatures, both of which showed an acceleration in warming, although at different times. mock_data.passageC1:
The escalating pace of global warming, now demonstrably twice as fast as in preceding decades, portends a future where the onset of major climate catastrophes could be significantly accelerated. This unnerving trend necessitates a reassessment of our preparedness and mitigation strategies, lest we find ourselves woefully unprepared for the far-reaching ramifications of a rapidly changing climate.

Prior to 2013-14, the Earth experienced warming at a rate of approximately 0.18°C per decade. However, a recent analysis conducted by Stefan Rahmstorf and his team at the University of Potsdam reveals a disturbing acceleration, with the planet now heating up at roughly 0.36°C per decade. This represents a twofold increase, a stark indicator of the escalating crisis.

Should this accelerated warming trajectory persist, humanity risks breaching the Paris Agreement's ambitious goal of limiting warming to 1.5°C as early as 2028, potentially even outpacing previous, already concerning, projections. The implications of such a breach are profound and demand immediate action.

Rahmstorf emphasizes the critical importance of even fractional degrees, stating, "Every tenth of a degree matters and makes the impact of global warming worse in terms of extreme weather events, in terms of ecosystem impacts, also the risk of crossing tipping points." He further underscores the global imperative to curb and ultimately reverse global warming, lamenting the fact that the current trend points in the opposite, and deeply troubling, direction. The global community, with the notable exception of the US, is striving to halt global warming; therefore, this countervailing trend is alarming.

Following a succession of record-breaking hot years, a vigorous debate emerged among climate scientists in 2023 regarding the potential acceleration of global warming. However, disentangling the signal of anthropogenic climate change from the noise of natural climate variability, such as the El Niño phenomenon which contributed to warming in 2023 and 2024, presented a considerable challenge. It was difficult to ascertain whether the observed temperature spikes were indicative of a genuine acceleration or merely transient fluctuations.

Rahmstorf's study distinguishes itself by providing the first statistically significant evidence of an acceleration attributable to climate change, achieving a high degree of confidence (98%). This robust finding lends considerable weight to the growing body of evidence suggesting a more rapid warming trend.

The research team meticulously analyzed five distinct global temperature datasets, some of which indicated even more pronounced warming. According to the analysis of data from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts, the critical threshold of 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels could be breached as early as this year, based on a 20-year average. Such a scenario would have grave consequences for vulnerable ecosystems and planetary stability.

The precarious state of warm-water coral reefs, already showing signs of widespread collapse, exemplifies the vulnerability of ecosystems to even marginal increases in temperature. Breaching the 1.5°C threshold risks triggering other potentially irreversible tipping points, such as the accelerated melting of the Greenland and West Antarctic ice sheets and the widespread dieback of the Amazon rainforest, with catastrophic consequences for global sea levels and biodiversity.

Many scientists posit that the observed acceleration in global heating is primarily attributable to the 2020 crackdown on sulphur dioxide emissions from the shipping industry. While these emissions undoubtedly posed a significant threat to human health, they also inadvertently created a haze of aerosols that reflected sunlight and exerted a cooling effect on the planet. This unintended consequence highlights the complex interplay of factors influencing global climate.

Now that this sunlight-blocking effect has been diminished, the warming rate may, in theory, decelerate, although Rahmstorf cautions against premature optimism. The ongoing transition away from fossil fuels will continue to reduce air pollution, thereby diminishing the masking effect on warming. The key question now is how these competing factors will interact.

"There will be further aerosol reductions, [but] probably not as rapid as those shipping emissions were reduced," he says. "It's quite possible that the warming rate will be lower in the next decade." This suggests that the immediate future may bring some respite, although the long-term trajectory remains uncertain.

The authors accounted for the influence of El Niño, volcanic eruptions (which release sun-blocking aerosols), and increased solar radiation during periods of heightened sunspot activity. After isolating these factors, they applied two distinct types of curve-fitting techniques to global temperature data, both of which revealed an acceleration in warming, albeit at different points in time. This methodological rigor strengthens the study's conclusions.

However, Zeke Hausfather of Berkeley Earth cautions that the study may slightly overestimate the magnitude of the acceleration, as it is unlikely that the researchers were able to completely eliminate the temperature effects of El Niño, volcanoes, and sunspots. This residual uncertainty underscores the inherent challenges of climate modeling and attribution.

Despite this caveat, Hausfather concludes that the study provides compelling evidence of an acceleration in global warming. "The broader takeaway is that we have strong evidence for acceleration even if we don't know precisely how much the rate of warming has increased as of yet," Hausfather says. "We will need to wait a few more years to get more data." The path forward requires continued monitoring, rigorous analysis, and, above all, decisive action to mitigate the escalating threat of climate change.

mock_data.translation:
Global isish tezlashdi va hozir oldingi o'n yilliklarga qaraganda ikki baravar tez sodir bo'lmoqda, ya'ni yirik iqlim falokatlari kutilganidan tezroq sodir bo'lishi mumkin.

Yer 2013–14 yilgacha har o'n yilda taxminan 0,18°C ga isigan. Shundan beri u har o'n yilda taxminan 0,36°C ga isib bormoqda, Germaniyaning Potsdam universitetidagi Stefan Rahmstorf va uning hamkasblari tomonidan o'tkazilgan tahlilga ko'ra.

Agar isish shu tezlikda davom etsa, insoniyat 2028 yilda isishni 1,5°C bilan cheklash bo'yicha Parij kelishuvi maqsadini buzishi mumkin, hatto boshqa tadqiqotlar bashorat qilganidan ham tezroq.

"Har bir o'ndan bir daraja muhim va global isishning ta'sirini ekstremal ob-havo hodisalari, ekotizim ta'sirlari va burilish nuqtalarini kesib o'tish xavfi nuqtai nazaridan yomonlashtiradi," deydi Rahmstorf. "AQShdan tashqari butun dunyo global isishni to'xtatishga, kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda va shuning uchun u hozir aslida teskarisini qilayotganligi, tezlashayotganligi katta tashvish tug'diradi."

Rekord darajada issiq yillar ketma-ketligidan so'ng, iqlim olimlari 2023 yilda global isish tezlashayotganmi deb keng muhokama qila boshladilar. Biroq tabiiy tebranishlar, masalan, 2023 va 2024 yillarda qo'shimcha isishga sabab bo'lgan El Ninyo iqlim fazasi, haroratning tezroq ko'tarilishi iqlim o'zgarishi yoki shunchaki tasodifiy ob-havo tufayli ekanligini aniqlashni qiyinlashtirdi.

Rahmstorfning tadqiqoti iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli statistik jihatdan muhim tezlanishni topgan birinchi tadqiqot bo'lib, bu bog'lanishni 98 foiz ishonch bilan aniqlagan.

Jamoa global haroratning beshta turli ma'lumotlar to'plamini tahlil qildi, ularning ba'zilari yuqoriroq raqamni ko'rsatadi. Yevropa O'rta Masofali Ob-havo Prognozlari Markazi ma'lumotlar to'plamining tahliliga ko'ra, global isish shu yili 20 yillik o'rtacha asosida sanoatdan oldingi davrdan 1,5°C ga yetishi mumkin.

Iliq suvli marjon riflari qulashni boshladi va 1,5°C dan oshish Grenlandiya va g'arbiy Antarktidaning qaytarib bo'lmas erishi va Amazon tropik o'rmonlarining nobud bo'lishi kabi boshqa burilish nuqtalarini kesib o'tish xavfini tug'diradi.

Ko'pgina olimlar global isishning tezlanishi asosan 2020 yilda kema qatnovi chiqindilaridagi oltingugurt dioksidiga qarshi qattiq choralar tufayli yuzaga kelgan deb hisoblaydi. Bu modda inson sog'lig'iga zararli bo'lsa-da, u shuningdek quyosh nurini to'sib, sayyorani sovutayotgan aerozollar tumanini hosil qildi.

Endi bu quyosh nuri ochilganligi sababli, isish tezligi sekinlashishi mumkin, lekin buni aniq aytish qiyin, deydi Rahmstorf. Qazilma yoqilg'idan o'tish isishni yashirayotgan havo ifloslanishini kamaytirishda davom etadi.

"Aerozollarning yanada kamayishi bo'ladi, [lekin] ehtimol kema qatnovi chiqindilari kamaytirilgandek tez emas," deydi u. "Keyingi o'n yillikda isish tezligi pastroq bo'lishi mumkin."

El Ninyodan tashqari, mualliflar vulqon otilishlarining ta'sirlarini, ular ham quyoshni to'sadigan tuman hosil qiladi, va yuqori quyosh dog'lari davrlarida ortgan quyosh nurlanishini baholadilar. Ushbu ta'sirlarni istisno qilgandan so'ng, ular global haroratlarga ikki turdagi egri chiziq moslashtirishdi, ularning ikkalasi ham turli vaqtlarda bo'lsa-da, isishda tezlanishni ko'rsatdi.

Biroq, tadqiqotchilar El Ninyo, vulqonlar va quyosh dog'larining harorat ta'sirlarini to'liq bartaraf eta olgan bo'lishlari dargumon, deydi Kaliforniyadagi Berkeley Earthdagi Zik Xausfater. Bu ularning global isish qanchalik tezlashganini biroz oshirib baholashi mumkinligini anglatadi. Ammo tadqiqot uning tezlashganiga ishonchli dalil taqdim etadi, deydi u.

"Kengroq xulosa shuki, isish tezligi qanchalik oshganini aniq bilmasak ham, tezlanish uchun kuchli dalillarimiz bor," deydi Xausfater. "Biz ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun yana bir necha yil kutishimiz kerak bo'ladi."

mock_data.translationB1:
Yer ilgari bo'lganidan tezroq isiyapti. Bu ob-havo bilan bog'liq katta muammolar biz o'ylaganimizdan erta yuz berishi mumkin degani.

2013-yilgacha Yer har o'n yilda taxminan 0.18°C ga isirdi. Ammo hozir har o'n yilda taxminan 0.36°C ga isiyapti. Bu ma'lumot Germaniyadagi Stefan Rahmstorf va boshqa olimlarning tadqiqotidan olingan.

Agar Yer shu tezlikda isishda davom etsa, biz isishni 1.5°C dan past darajada ushlab tura olmasligimiz mumkin. Bu iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish bo'yicha xalqaro kelishuv bo'lgan Parij kelishuvining maqsadi. Biz bu chegaraga hatto ba'zi olimlar bashorat qilganidan ham tezroq, 2028-yilgacha yetishimiz mumkin.

Rahmstorfning aytishicha, hatto ozgina isish ham vaziyatni yomonlashtirishi mumkin. Bu juda kuchli bo'ronlar yoki juda issiq haroratlar kabi ko'proq favqulodda ob-havoga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, u tabiatga zarar yetkazishi va tuzatish qiyin bo'lgan katta muammolar xavfini oshirishi mumkin. Ko'pgina davlatlar global isishni to'xtatish yoki sekinlashtirishga harakat qilmoqda. Shunday ekan, uning hozir tezlashayotgani katta xavotir.

2023-yilda, juda issiq yillardan so'ng, olimlar global isish tezlashayaptimi degan savolni ko'tara boshladilar. Ammo buni aniq bilish qiyin edi. Chunki ob-havoda El-Ninyo kabi tabiiy o'zgarishlar mavjud. El-Ninyo 2023 va 2024-yillarda Yerni isitdi. Shunday ekan, tezroq isish iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli bo'layaptimi yoki shunchaki ob-havo tufaylimi, buni aniqlash qiyin edi.

Rahmstorfning tadqiqoti iqlim o'zgarishi haqiqatan ham isishni tezlashtirayotganini ko'rsatgan birinchi tadqiqotdir. Olimlar bunga 98% ishonch hosil qilishgan.

Olimlar global harorat haqidagi besh xil ma'lumot to'plamini ko'rib chiqdilar. Ushbu to'plamlarning ba'zilari yuqori haroratni ko'rsatdi. Yevropa o'rta muddatli ob-havo prognozlari markazidan olingan ma'lumotlarga ko'ra, dunyo shu yil sanoat inqilobidan oldingidan 1.5°C ga issiqroq bo'lishi mumkin. Bu 20 yil davomidagi o'rtacha haroratni ko'rib chiqishga asoslangan.

Marjon riflari suv juda issiq bo'lgani uchun allaqachon o'la boshladi. Agar Yer 1.5°C ga issiqroq bo'lsa, boshqa katta muammolar yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Misol uchun, Grenlandiya va G'arbiy Antarktidadagi muzlar butunlay erishi va Amazon o'rmonlari nobud bo'lishi mumkin.

Ko'pgina olimlar isish 2020-yilda yangi qoida tufayli tezlashayotganini o'ylashadi. Qoida kemalar havoga chiqarishi mumkin bo'lgan oltingugurt dioksidi miqdorini chekladi. Oltingugurt dioksidi odamlarning sog'lig'i uchun zararli, lekin u quyosh nurini to'sib, Yerni sovutadigan tuman ham yaratdi.

Endi bu tuman kamroq bo'lgani uchun, quyosh nuri Yerga ko'proq yetib bormoqda va harorat ko'tarilmoqda. Isish kelajakda sekinlashishi mumkin, ammo buni aniq aytish qiyin, deydi Rahmstorf. Biz qazilma yoqilg'idan foydalanishni to'xtatganimiz sari, isishni yashirayotgan havo ifloslanishi kamayadi.

Rahmstorfning aytishicha, havoda ifloslanish kamroq bo'ladi, lekin kemalar uchun qoidalar o'zgargandagi kabi tez bo'lmasligi mumkin. Uning fikricha, isish keyingi o'n yilda unchalik tez bo'lmasligi mumkin.

Olimlar, shuningdek, vulqon otilishlari va quyoshdagi o'zgarishlarning ta'sirini ham ko'rib chiqdilar. Vulqon otilishlari quyosh nurini to'sib qo'yadigan tuman yaratishi mumkin. Quyosh ham ma'lum vaqtlarda ko'proq energiya chiqarishi mumkin. Ushbu narsalarni hisobga olgandan so'ng, olimlar Yer tezroq isiyayotganini aniqladilar.

Biroq, boshqa bir olim, Zeke Hausfatherning aytishicha, Yer qanchalik tez isiyayotganini aniq bilish qiyin. U olimlar El-Ninyo, vulqonlar va quyoshning ta'sirini to'liq olib tashlay olmagan bo'lishi mumkinligini aytdi. Ammo u tadqiqot Yer tezroq isiyayotganini ko'rsatishiga rozi.

Hausfatherning aytishicha, muhimi, bizda isish tezlashayotganiga yaxshi dalil bor, hatto qanchalik ekanligini aniq bilmasak ham. U ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun yana bir necha yil kutishimiz kerakligini aytdi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Yerning isishi tezligi tez sur'atlar bilan oshib bormoqda, hozirda avvalgi o'n yilliklarga nisbatan ikki barobar tezroq sodir bo'lmoqda. Bu shuni anglatadiki, biz avval o'ylaganimizdan ham tezroq jiddiy iqlim ofatlariga duch kelishimiz mumkin.

2013-14 yillargacha Yer harorati har o'n yilda taxminan 0,18°C ga ko'tarilardi. Biroq, Germaniyaning Potsdam universitetida Stefan Rahmstorf va uning jamoasi tomonidan o'tkazilgan tadqiqotga ko'ra, bu tezlik o'shandan beri har o'n yilda taxminan 0,36°C ga oshdi. Bu jiddiy e'tibor talab qiladigan xavotirli tendentsiyani ko'rsatadi.

Agar isishning bu tezligi davom etsa, biz Parij kelishuvining global isishni 1,5°C bilan cheklash maqsadini 2028 yilgacha oshirib yuborishimiz mumkin. Bu boshqa tadqiqotlar tomonidan bashorat qilinganidan ham erta bo'lib, vaziyatning dolzarbligini ta'kidlaydi.

Rahmstorf shunday tushuntiradi: "Har bir darajaning o'ndan bir qismi ham ahamiyatga ega va global isishning ta'sirini yomonlashtiradi, bu esa ekstremal ob-havo hodisalariga, ekotizimlarning shikastlanishiga va kritik burilish nuqtalariga yetib borish xavfini oshiradi." Uning qo'shimcha qilishicha, "AQShdan tashqari dunyo global isishni to'xtatish va kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda. Hozirda uning tezlashayotgani juda xavotirli."

Rekord darajadagi haroratlarning bir necha yillaridan so'ng, iqlimshunoslar 2023-yilda global isish haqiqatan ham tezlashayotganmi degan bahslarni boshladilar. Biroq, 2023 va 2024-yillarda qo'shimcha isishga sabab bo'lgan El-Nino iqlim namunasi kabi tabiiy o'zgarishlar, haroratning tezroq ko'tarilishi iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli yuzaga kelganmi yoki shunchaki tasodifiy ob-havo hodisalarimi, aniqlashni qiyinlashtirdi.

Rahmstorfning tadqiqoti tezlashuvni iqlim o'zgarishi bilan yuqori darajadagi ishonch (98 foiz ishonch) bilan aniq bog'lagan birinchi tadqiqotdir. Bu inson faoliyati sayyoramiz haroratiga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatayotganiga kuchli dalil beradi.

Jamoa global harorat ma'lumotlarining beshta turli to'plamini tahlil qildi, ularning ba'zilari hatto undan ham yuqori raqamlarni ko'rsatdi. Yevropa o'rta muddatli ob-havo prognozlari markazining ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, global isish 20 yillik o'rtacha ko'rsatkich asosida bu yil sanoatdan oldingi davrga nisbatan 1,5°C ga yetishi mumkin. Bu vaziyatning potensial jiddiyligini ta'kidlaydi.

Iliq suvli marjon riflari allaqachon juda azob chekishni boshladi va 1,5°C dan oshib ketish Grenlandiya va G'arbiy Antarktikaning qaytarib bo'lmaydigan tarzda erishi va Amazon o'rmonining o'lishi kabi boshqa burilish nuqtalarini qo'zg'atish xavfini tug'diradi. Bu hodisalar sayyora uchun halokatli oqibatlarga olib keladi.

Ko'pgina olimlarning fikricha, global isishning tezlashishi, asosan, 2020-yilda kemalardan oltingugurt dioksidi emissiyasiga qarshi qat'iy choralar ko'rilganligi bilan bog'liq. Bu modda inson salomatligi uchun zararli bo'lsa-da, u quyosh nurini qaytaradigan va sayyoraga sovutuvchi ta'sir ko'rsatadigan aerozollar tumanini ham yaratdi.

Endi bu quyosh nuri to'silmayotgan ekan, isish tezligi sekinlashishi mumkin, ammo bu aniq emas, deydi Rahmstorf. Qazilma yoqilg'idan voz kechish isishning haqiqiy darajasini niqoblayotgan havo ifloslanishini kamaytirishda davom etadi.

"Aerozollarning kamayishi davom etadi, ammo kemalar emissiyasi kamayganidek tez emas", deydi u. "Keyingi o'n yillikda isish tezligi pastroq bo'lishi mumkin." Bu kelajakda potensial o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi.

El-Nino'dan tashqari, tadqiqotchilar vulqon otilishlarining ta'sirini ham ko'rib chiqdilar, ular ham quyoshni to'sadigan tuman yaratadi va quyosh dog'lari faolligi yuqori bo'lgan davrlarda quyosh radiatsiyasining ko'payishi. Bu omillarni hisobga olgan holda, ular global haroratni tahlil qilish uchun ikkita turdagi egri chiziqdan foydalanganlar, ularning ikkalasi ham isishning tezlashuvini ko'rsatdi, garchi turli vaqtlarda bo'lsa ham. Bu tezlashuv uchun dalilni kuchaytiradi.

Biroq, Kaliforniyadagi Berkeley Earth kompaniyasidan Zeke Hausfather, tadqiqotchilar El-Nino, vulqonlar va quyosh dog'larining haroratga ta'sirini to'liq olib tashlay olmagan bo'lishlari mumkin, deb hisoblaydi. Bu shuni anglatadiki, ular global isishning qanchalik tezlashganini biroz yuqori baholashlari mumkin. Shunga qaramay, u tadqiqot tezlashuvning ishonchli dalilini taqdim etishiga qo'shiladi. U keyingi tekshiruv zarurligini ta'kidlaydi.

"Asosiy nuqta shundaki, isish tezligi qanchalik oshganini aniq bilmasak ham, tezlashuv uchun kuchli dalilga egamiz", deydi Hausfather. "Ko'proq ma'lumot to'plash uchun yana bir necha yil kutishimiz kerak." Bu iqlim tadqiqotlarining doimiy xarakterini va doimiy monitoring zarurligini ta'kidlaydi.

Global isishning tezligi so'nggi o'n yilliklarga nisbatan ikki barobar tezlashgani kelajakda yirik iqlim falokatlari sezilarli darajada tezlashishi mumkinligidan darak beradi. Bu xavotirli tendentsiya o'zgaruvchan iqlimning keng ko'lamli oqibatlariga tayyorgarligimiz va yumshatish strategiyalarimizni qayta ko'rib chiqishni talab qiladi, aks holda biz o'zimizni juda tayyorgarliksiz topamiz.

2013-14-yillarga qadar Yer har o'n yillikda taxminan 0,18°C darajada isigan. Biroq, Potsdam universiteti professori Stefan Ramstorf va uning jamoasi tomonidan o'tkazilgan so'nggi tahlil sayyoramizning hozirda har o'n yillikda taxminan 0,36°C darajada isishi bilan xavotirli tezlashuvni ko'rsatdi. Bu ikki barobar oshishni anglatadi, bu esa kuchayib borayotgan inqirozning aniq ko'rsatkichidir.

Agar bu tezlashgan isish traektoriyasi davom etsa, insoniyat Parij kelishuvining isishni 1,5°C darajasida cheklash bo'yicha ulkan maqsadiga 2028-yilgacha, hatto avvalgi, allaqachon xavotirli bo'lgan prognozlardan ham o'tib ketish xavfini tug'diradi. Bunday buzilishning oqibatlari juda chuqur va zudlik bilan harakat qilishni talab qiladi.

Ramstorf har bir darajaning o'ndan bir qismi ham muhim ekanligini ta'kidlab, "Har bir darajaning o'ndan bir qismi muhim va global isishning ta'sirini ekstremal ob-havo hodisalari, ekotizimga ta'siri va o'zgarish nuqtalaridan o'tish xavfi nuqtai nazaridan yomonlashtiradi", dedi. U, shuningdek, global isishni to'xtatish va oxir-oqibatda teskari yo'naltirishning global zarurligini ta'kidlab, hozirgi tendentsiya buning aksini ko'rsatayotganidan afsusda. AQShdan tashqari, global hamjamiyat global isishni to'xtatishga intilmoqda; shuning uchun bu qarama-qarshi tendentsiya tashvishlidir.

Ketma-ket rekord darajadagi issiq yillardan so'ng, 2023-yilda iqlimshunoslar o'rtasida global isishning potentsial tezlashuvi haqida qizg'in munozaralar paydo bo'ldi. Biroq, antropogen iqlim o'zgarishi signalini 2023 va 2024-yillarda isishga hissa qo'shgan El-Ninyo hodisasi kabi tabiiy iqlim o'zgaruvchanligining shovqinidan ajratib olish jiddiy muammo edi. Kuzatilgan haroratning keskin ko'tarilishi haqiqiy tezlashuvdan dalolat beradimi yoki shunchaki o'tkinchi tebranishlarmi, aniqlash qiyin edi.

Ramstorfning tadqiqoti iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli tezlashuvning birinchi statistik jihatdan muhim dalilini taqdim etishi bilan ajralib turadi va yuqori darajadagi ishonchga (98%) erishadi. Bu ishonchli topilma tezroq isish tendentsiyasini ko'rsatadigan dalillarning ko'payib borayotgan qismiga katta ahamiyat beradi.

Tadqiqot guruhi beshta alohida global harorat ma'lumotlar to'plamini sinchkovlik bilan tahlil qildi, ularning ba'zilari yanada aniqroq isishni ko'rsatdi. Yevropa o'rta muddatli ob-havo prognozlari markazidan olingan ma'lumotlar tahliliga ko'ra, sanoatdan oldingi davrdan 1,5°C yuqori bo'lgan muhim chegara 20 yillik o'rtacha ko'rsatkich asosida shu yilning o'zida buzilishi mumkin. Bunday ssenariy zaif ekotizimlar va sayyoraning barqarorligi uchun jiddiy oqibatlarga olib keladi.

Iliq suvli marjon riflarining xavfli holati allaqachon keng ko'lamli qulash belgilarini ko'rsatmoqda, bu ekotizimlarning haroratning hatto marginal o'sishiga ham zaifligini ko'rsatadi. 1,5°C chegarasidan o'tish boshqa qaytarib bo'lmaydigan o'zgarish nuqtalarini, masalan, Grenlandiya va G'arbiy Antarktida muz qatlamlarining tezlashgan erishi va Amazon o'rmonining keng ko'lamli qisqarishini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, bu global dengiz sathining ko'tarilishi va biologik xilma-xillik uchun falokatli oqibatlarga olib keladi.

Ko'pgina olimlarning fikricha, global isishning kuzatilgan tezlashuvi, birinchi navbatda, 2020-yilda yuk tashish sanoatidan oltingugurt dioksidi emissiyasiga qarshi kurashish bilan bog'liq. Ushbu emissiyalar, shubhasiz, inson salomatligiga katta tahdid solgan bo'lsa-da, ular quyosh nurini aks ettiruvchi va sayyoraga sovutish ta'sirini ko'rsatuvchi aerozollarning tumanini ham beixtiyor yaratdi. Ushbu kutilmagan oqibat global iqlimga ta'sir etuvchi omillarning murakkab o'zaro ta'sirini ta'kidlaydi.

Endi bu quyosh nurini to'sib qo'yuvchi ta'sir kamayganligi sababli, isish tezligi nazariy jihatdan sekinlashishi mumkin, garchi Ramstorf erta optimizmga qarshi ogohlantirmoqda. Qazilma yoqilg'idan voz kechish davom etar ekan, havo ifloslanishi kamayishda davom etadi va shu bilan isishga niqob ta'sirini kamaytiradi. Asosiy savol hozirda ushbu raqobatdosh omillar qanday o'zaro ta'sir qilishi.

Uning so'zlariga ko'ra, "Aerozollarning kamayishi davom etadi, [lekin] ehtimol yuk tashish emissiyasining kamayishi kabi tez bo'lmaydi". "Kelgusi o'n yillikda isish tezligi pastroq bo'lishi mumkin". Bu yaqin kelajakda biroz yengillik bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi, garchi uzoq muddatli traektoriya noaniqligicha qolmoqda.

Mualliflar El-Ninyo, vulqon otilishi (quyoshni to'sib qo'yuvchi aerozollarni chiqaradi) va quyosh dog'lari faolligi kuchaygan davrlarda quyosh radiatsiyasining ko'payishi ta'sirini hisobga olishdi. Ushbu omillarni ajratib olgandan so'ng, ular global harorat ma'lumotlariga ikkita alohida egri chiziqli moslash usullarini qo'llashdi, ularning ikkalasi ham isishning tezlashuvini ko'rsatdi, garchi turli vaqtlarda bo'lsa ham. Ushbu metodologik qat'iylik tadqiqot xulosalarini mustahkamlaydi.

Biroq, Berkeley Earth vakili Zeke Hausfatherning ogohlantirishicha, tadqiqot tezlashuvning miqdorini biroz oshirib yuborishi mumkin, chunki tadqiqotchilar El-Ninyo, vulqonlar va quyosh dog'larining harorat ta'sirini to'liq bartaraf eta olmagan bo'lishi mumkin. Bu qoldiq noaniqlik iqlimni modellashtirish va atributsiyaning o'ziga xos qiyinchiliklarini ta'kidlaydi.

Ushbu ogohlantirishga qaramay, Hausfather tadqiqot global isishning tezlashuvining ishonchli dalillarini taqdim etadi degan xulosaga keladi. "Kattaroq xulosa shundan iboratki, bizda tezlashuv uchun kuchli dalillar mavjud, hatto isish tezligi hozirgacha qanchalik oshganini aniq bilmasak ham", dedi Hausfather. "Ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun biz yana bir necha yil kutishimiz kerak bo'ladi". Oldinga yo'l doimiy monitoring, qat'iy tahlil va, eng muhimi, iqlim o'zgarishining kuchayib borayotgan tahdidini yumshatish uchun qat'iy harakatlarni talab qiladi.
